items.title: Jensen Huang vs. Steve Jobs: Can Nvidia also thrive without its visionary?
items.summary:
Longtime Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive following a string of personal controversies.

Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman chats with SoFi (SOFI) chief market strategist Liz Thomas and Moor Insights & Strategy founder Patrick Moorhead at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss the parallels between Steve Jobs for Apple (AAPL) and Huang for Nvidia.
